question: Where in India was the most complete fossil of rare dinosaur-Ichthyosaur found in 2016?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gujrat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ichthyosaur **is a **152 million-year-old fossil**.
 
• It was **discovered **for the **first time in India **(Kutch desert region of Gujarat).
 
• **Rajasaurus **is a **genus **of **carnivorous abelisaurid theropod dinosaurs **from the **Late Cretaceous of India**.
 
• **Masiakasaur **is **a genus of small predatory theropod dinosaurs **from the Late Cretaceous of Madagascar.
 
• In **Malagasy**, **masiaka **means "**vicious"; **this genus name means "vicious lizard".
 
• **Barapasaurus **is a **genus of basal sauropod dinosaur **from the **Early Jurassic rocks of India**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dinosaurs**:

 
 
• **dinosaurs **are a **diverse group **of **reptiles **of the **clade Dinosauria**.
 
• They first **appeared during **the **Triassic period**, between **243 and 233.23 **million years ago, although the exact origin and timing of the **evolution **of **dinosaurs **is the **subject of active research**.
